outcomes.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

nodes.question: Is the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image still identifiable in the edited image, and if so, what is its color?
nodes.criteria: Track the same small rectangular DVD case visible near the center of the source image into the edited image using its shape, position, and visual continuity. Complete only if that same case is visibly white. Partial only if the same case is identifiable and visibly changed from black toward white but is not yet white. Absent if the same case remains black without a requested color change, or if it is missing/replaced and there is no visual evidence that it changed toward white. A nearby white disc or other object is not evidence of progress unless continuity establishes it is the same case. Unknown only if the images do not permit determining whether the same case changed color.
nodes.binding: Source target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image. Track that exact object into the edited image; do not substitute a nearby disc or other object.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
